name: DECIBAN — proposition-level Bayesian evidence model (v0.2)
model: DECIBAN grades assertions, not addresses. A site is a container of independently scored propositions (EXISTS / EXTENT / HARDENED / FEDERAL / FUNCTION[T] / STATUS[S] / LOCATION / PROGRAM[X]), each carrying its own prior in decibans of log-odds, its own mandatory named alternative hypothesis, and its own ledger of signed, verified observations. Every observation contributes a log-likelihood ratio against that named alternative rather than points for being present, so a ventilation shaft above a limestone mine contributes exactly zero and a lease agreement contributes strongly NEGATIVE to the bunker hypothesis because it is expected under the alternative and surprising under the claim. Agents never produce a probability. They answer two four-level anchored questions per observation — how expected is this if the claim is true, how expected if the named alternative is true — and read a likelihood band off a fixed 4x4 matrix whose ceiling is +/-13 dB; the two strong bands (+/-20, +/-40 dB) are unreachable by inference and require a verified source that states the proposition on its face, which is what makes one conclusive primary document sufficient on its own and makes fabrication expensive. Absence of evidence is a scored observation whose weight is set by a published expected-record table, so silence counts against a claim only where the silence is surprising: no MILCON line for a Federal Reserve facility is worth zero, no MILCON line for an appropriated-agency facility is worth -13 dB. Corroboration is arithmetic addition across independent lineages after semantic-claim deduplication, which means 400 websites repeating one origin contribute once and contamination reaches the floor by construction rather than by multiplier. The published output per proposition is a pair: a posterior probability band with an explicit uncertainty interval, and a separate ordinal record-quality grade — so the register can say the hole is certain, the record is testimonial, and the function is unsupported, all on one page, without contradiction.
full_specification:
================================================================
DECIBAN v0.2.0 — COMPLETE SCORING SPECIFICATION
Bunkers register. Supersedes WORKFLOW.md section 1 in its entirety.
Self-contained: an agent may apply this with no further context.
================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------
0. UNITS AND THE ONE EQUATION
--------------------------------------------------------------

All scoring is in DECIBANS (dB) of log-odds.

    L = 10 * log10(odds)
    P = 1 / (1 + 10^(-L/10))

The entire model is one line, applied once per proposition:

    L_post  =  L_prior  +  SIGMA( w_i )

where w_i are the deciban weights of the surviving observations in
that proposition's ledger, after verification, tier capping, lineage
deduplication, fact-key merging and channel capping (sections 6-10).

Reference values (memorise these; they are the whole scale):
   L = +40 -> P 0.9999   L = +20 -> P 0.990   L = +13 -> P 0.952
   L = +7  -> P 0.834    L = +3  -> P 0.666   L = 0   -> P 0.500
   L = -7  -> P 0.166    L = -13 -> P 0.048   L = -20 -> P 0.0099
   L = -40 -> P 0.0001

There is no multiplier anywhere in this model. There is no weighted
mean. There are no axes. Contamination, corroboration, diagnosticity
and refutation are all expressed as deciban terms in the same sum.

--------------------------------------------------------------
1. THE PROPOSITION LADDER (mandatory; the unit of grading)
--------------------------------------------------------------

A SITE is a container. It is never graded. Only PROPOSITIONS are
graded. Every site record instantiates rows from this fixed ladder:

 ID   PROPOSITION                                  PARENT
 ---  -------------------------------------------  -------
 P1   EXISTS: a constructed object exists at the    (root)
      stated location
 P2   EXTENT[d]: the object's depth/area/volume is  P1
      within a factor of 2 of the claimed value d
 P3   HARDENED: engineered protection against       P1
      blast, radiation, EMP or forced entry beyond
      ordinary construction of its class
 P4   FEDERAL: built, owned, leased or operated by  P1
      or for a government entity (US federal unless
      the row states otherwise)
 P5   FUNCTION[T]: the object serves or served      P1
      function T. ONE ROW PER CLAIMED TYPOLOGY.
 P6   STATUS[S]: current operational status is S    P1
 P7   LOCATION[p]: the object is at the stated      P1
      coordinates to precision p
      (p in {exact <=100 m, approximate <=1 km,
       regional <=25 km})
 P8   PROGRAM[X]: a named program/project X existed  (root,
      and this record is an instance of it           independent
                                                     of P1)

RULES

1.1  MONOTONE CLAMP. A published child posterior may not exceed its
     parent's: P_pub(child) = min(P(child), P(parent)). Applied after
     scoring, recorded as a clamp event. P8 is NOT clamped by P1 —
     that is what makes DUCC representable (PROGRAM A, EXISTS R).

1.2  TYPOLOGY IS A PROPOSITION. The register's default typology is
     `unknown-anomaly`, which generates NO P5 row and NO badge. Any
     other typology REQUIRES a P5 row with its own ledger. A P5 row
     may not exceed grade D without at least one VERIFIED,
     INSTANCE-LEVEL source that names the function (this falls out of
     section 5's gate, it is not a special case). Typology cannot be
     changed by editing a field; it is changed by opening a
     proposition and evidencing it.

1.3  THE HEADLINE BADGE of a site entry is the highest-posterior P5
     row, displayed with its grade, beside the P1 grade. Never one
     number. A site with P1=A and P5[COG]=R prints exactly that.

1.4  MULTIPLE TYPOLOGIES COEXIST WITHOUT CONTRADICTION. Louisville
     Mega Cavern publishes P5[commercial-storage]=A,
     P5[civil-defense-shelter-designation]=A, P5[COG]=R.

1.5  Every proposition row carries: prior_table_version,
     rubric_version, scorer_model_id, H_alt_id, reference_class,
     search_completeness_index, and the full observation ledger.

--------------------------------------------------------------
2. THE MANDATORY ALTERNATIVE HYPOTHESIS
--------------------------------------------------------------

No proposition may be scored without a NAMED H_alt. H_alt is chosen
by REFUTER from this enumerated set (extensible by reviewed write):

  A01 no constructed object at this location
  A02 commercial or industrial mine, quarry, or cavern warehouse
  A03 highway, rail or transit tunnel
  A04 water, sewer or flood-control works
  A05 utility vault, substation enclosure, or pipeline works
  A06 agricultural, cold or general storage
  A07 commercial data centre or telecom exchange (unhardened)
  A08 ordinary above-ground government building
  A09 duplicate of an already-registered entity
  A10 civil-defence shelter designation only (no construction)
  A11 claim fabricated, misattributed, or transposed from another site
  A12 decommissioned facility of a DIFFERENT, already-known typology

2.1  H_alt must be the STRONGEST SURVIVING alternative, not the
     easiest to dismiss. REFUTER states why the others are weaker.

2.2  A11 is MANDATORY as a co-alternative on any proposition whose
     positive support includes a channel-9 (fringe corpus) lineage.
     Both H_alt scorings are run; the one producing the LOWER
     posterior is published (conservative selection).

2.3  DEFAULT IF UNNAMED: H_alt = A01 for P1, A11 for all others, and
     the proposition is HARD-CAPPED AT GRADE D until REFUTER names
     one. An unadjudicated candidate cannot be strongly evidenced.

2.4  REFUTER runs on every proposition graded C, D, E, F, R **and A**.
     (Inverted threshold: scrutiny goes where error lives and where
     the register's exposure is largest, not to the obvious cases.)

--------------------------------------------------------------
3. REFERENCE CLASSES (assignable with zero claim-specific evidence)
--------------------------------------------------------------

 RC1  Interior of an acknowledged federal or military installation
 RC2  Federal land outside an installation boundary
 RC3  Extractive or heavy-industrial site (mine, quarry, plant)
 RC4  Purpose-built critical-infrastructure structure (telephone
      exchange, utility control centre, financial operations centre,
      broadcast/relay site, airport, data centre)
 RC5  Ordinary private land or ordinary building
 RC6  Non-located (no coordinates asserted, or claimed-only)

3.1  Reference class is determined from the parcel/land-status record
     and the object's ordinary, undisputed commercial identity — never
     from the claim under test.
3.2  IF AMBIGUOUS, take the class giving the LOWEST prior for the
     proposition being scored. Conservative by construction.

--------------------------------------------------------------
4. PRIOR TABLE v0.2.0 (deciban log-odds; published, versioned)
--------------------------------------------------------------

                                RC1   RC2   RC3   RC4   RC5   RC6
 P1 EXISTS                      +13     0   +13   +13    +3   -13
 P2 EXTENT-AS-CLAIMED            -7    -7    -7    -7    -7   -13
 P3 HARDENED                     -7   -13   -20    -7   -20   -20
 P4 FEDERAL                     +13    +3   -20   -13   -20   -13
 P5 FUNCTION, SENSITIVE set*    -13   -20   -25   -20   -25   -25
 P5 FUNCTION, MUNDANE set**      -7   -10    -7    -7   -13   -20
 P6 STATUS[S]                    -3    -3    -3    -3    -3    -3
 P7 LOCATION exact / approx /   -7 / 0 / +7  (all reference classes)
       regional
 P8 PROGRAM[X]                  -13   -13   -13   -13   -13   -13

  * SENSITIVE typologies: COG/COOP, nuclear command & control,
    nuclear weapons storage, SIGINT/collection, special-access
    research, detention.
 ** MUNDANE typologies: storage & archive, civil-defence shelter,
    communications relay, missile silo, general research, data
    centre, private commercial shelter, military support.

4.1  ORIGIN OF THESE NUMBERS. -25 dB = odds 1:316. The published
     justification: on the order of a few hundred genuinely hardened
     federal facilities exist in CONUS against tens of thousands of
     anthropogenic underground structures (mines, quarries, highway
     and rail tunnels, utility vaults, cold-storage caverns,
     civil-defence basements). RC3's -25 for a sensitive typology is
     that ratio. RC1's -13 (1:20) reflects that most structures inside
     a military installation are not COG facilities but the base rate
     is two orders of magnitude higher than off-installation. Every
     cell carries its arithmetic on the methodology page.

4.2  MAXIMUM PRIOR MAGNITUDE IS +/-25 dB, by rule. A single band-+5
     observation (+40 dB) always overwhelms the worst prior. Evidence
     can always defeat the prior; that is the model's robustness
     guarantee against a mis-specified table.

4.3  CLASS-LEVEL EVIDENCE MODIFIES THE PRIOR, NEVER THE LEDGER.
     A source that documents a PROGRAM of N instances without
     identifying which candidates they are contributes:

        prior_bonus = 10 * log10(N / M),  clamped to [-10, +10]

     where M = number of live candidates in the register competing for
     those N slots (M >= N enforced). Example: WHCA/Army Signal Agency
     records establish ~8 Presidential Emergency Facilities; 12
     candidate hilltops are registered; bonus = 10*log10(8/12) = -1.8
     dB to each. Adding candidates DILUTES. M is recomputed on every
     candidate write and the recomputation is a versioned transition
     with cause CLASS-DENOMINATOR-CHANGE.

4.4  WHEN THE PRIORS ARE WRONG. Three defences:
     (a) BOUNDED INFLUENCE (4.2) — no grade above C can rest on the
         prior alone, because the ledger must carry >= +32 dB from
         -25 to reach +7.
     (b) PUBLISHED SENSITIVITY — every proposition publishes its
         PRIOR BREAK-EVEN: the dB shift in the prior that would move
         it one grade band. If |break-even| <= 7 dB the row is
         flagged PRIOR-SENSITIVE on the entry page.
     (c) EMPIRICAL RE-DERIVATION — after every 50 propositions that
         reach grade A or R, the realised base rate per
         (proposition x reference class) is recomputed from resolved
         cases and the table is re-issued as a new version. All
         affected rows are re-scored against BOTH the pinned old
         table and the new one; only the delta attributable to the
         table is published, labelled PRIOR-REVISION, and it is
         excluded from the confidence-history chart's evidence
         narrative.

--------------------------------------------------------------
5. THE LIKELIHOOD BAND SCALE (what an agent actually assigns)
--------------------------------------------------------------

 Band   Name              LR        dB     Reachable by
 ----   ----------------  --------  -----  ----------------------
  +5    CONCLUSIVE        10,000    +40    EXPLICIT-STATEMENT GATE
  +4    DECISIVE             100    +20    EXPLICIT-STATEMENT GATE
  +3    STRONG                20    +13    E/A matrix or gate
  +2    MODERATE               5     +7    E/A matrix
  +1    SLIGHT                 2     +3    E/A matrix
   0    INERT                  1      0    E/A matrix
  -1    SLIGHT AGAINST       0.5     -3    E/A matrix
  -2    MODERATE AGAINST     0.2     -7    E/A matrix
  -3    STRONG AGAINST      0.05    -13    E/A matrix or gate
  -4    DECISIVE AGAINST    0.01    -20    EXPLICIT-STATEMENT GATE
  -5    CONCLUSIVE AGAINST  0.0001  -40    EXPLICIT-STATEMENT GATE

STRUCTURAL PROPERTY: INFERENCE CANNOT EXCEED +/-13 dB PER
OBSERVATION. Bands +/-4 and +/-5 are unreachable through the matrix.
They require a source that states the proposition on its face. This is
the firewall, and it is arithmetic rather than a cap bolted on.

5.1  THE E/A MATRIX — the assignment procedure for inferential
     observations. The agent answers two questions, each on a
     four-level anchored scale, and reads the band off the table.

     Q1. EXPECTEDNESS UNDER H (the proposition is true):
       E3 REQUIRED    — would almost always exist AND be findable  (0.9)
       E2 LIKELY      — commonly present under H                   (0.6)
       E1 POSSIBLE    — could occur under H, not typical           (0.2)
       E0 SURPRISING  — would rarely occur under H                 (0.03)

     Q2. EXPECTEDNESS UNDER H_alt (the named alternative is true):
       A3 / A2 / A1 / A0 — same four anchors, same probabilities.

              A3     A2     A1     A0
        E3     0      0     +1     +3
        E2     0      0     +1     +3
        E1    -1     -1      0     +2
        E0    -3     -3     -2      0

     Derived as 10*log10(p_E / p_A) and ROUNDED TOWARD ZERO to the
     nearest band. Rounding toward zero is deliberate: it is the
     anti-inflation direction.

     WORKED ANCHORS (publish these verbatim for scorers):
       ventilation shaft, H=hardened facility, H_alt=A02 mine:
            E3 / A3  ->  band 0.  Contributes nothing. Ever.
       spoil pile, same pair:                    E3/A3 -> 0
       anomalous road grade into terrain:        E3/A3 -> 0
       deep water well:                          E3/A3 -> 0
       rail spur:                                E2/A3 -> 0
       dedicated substation:                     E3/A2 -> 0
       restricted airspace overlay (P-/R- area): E3/A0 -> +3 (+13 dB)
       blast valve / blast door line item in a
         filed permit or disposal record:        E3/A0 -> +3 (+13 dB)
       EMP-hardening spec in a procurement doc:  E3/A0 -> +3 (+13 dB)
       published tenant lease list:              E0/A3 -> -3 (-13 dB)
       operator-run public tours / zip line:     E0/A3 -> -3 (-13 dB)
       MSHA regulated-mine permit, H=hardened:   E1/A3 -> -1 ( -3 dB)

5.2  THE EXPLICIT-STATEMENT GATE (bands +/-4, +/-5).

     BAND +5 CONCLUSIVE requires ALL of:
       (a) institutional tier P1 or P2, verification tier V2;
       (b) scope = INSTANCE (names this facility, parcel, coordinate,
           or an identifier that resolves to it);
       (c) the receipted verbatim span STATES THE PROPOSITION ON ITS
           FACE — for FUNCTION it names the function; for HARDENED it
           specifies protective engineering; for FEDERAL it names the
           custodial agency;
       (d) the issuing body has AUTHORITY OVER THE FACT (an agency
           describing its own facility; a court; a recorder of deeds
           for title; a licensing authority for a licence);
       (e) causal provenance UNSOLICITED or SOLICITED-BY-THIRD-PARTY;
       (f) no unresolved authenticity challenge on the record.

     BAND +4 DECISIVE: exactly one of (a), (c), (d) fails but the
     source still explicitly asserts the instance-level proposition
     (e.g. P3 investigative journalism with named federal sourcing;
     a P1 record naming facility and location but only implying
     function).

     BAND -5 CONCLUSIVE AGAINST: an authoritative instance-level
     record affirmatively stating the NEGATION; or a verified record
     documenting the FABRICATION or MISATTRIBUTION of the claim's
     origin (this is where REFUTER gets its numeric hook).
     BAND -4: a named authoritative source explicitly denying the
     proposition, one gate condition short of -5.

5.3  DOCUMENTARY SUFFICIENCY IS EMERGENT, NOT AN OVERRIDE.
     Worst possible prior (-25) + one band-+5 observation (+40) =
     +15 dB = P 0.969 = GRADE B. A single conclusive primary document
     naming facility, location and function therefore cannot land
     below B. No special case is needed and none is written.

--------------------------------------------------------------
6. VERIFICATION TIERS (schema constraint, not agent diligence)
--------------------------------------------------------------

Every source row REQUIRES a retrieval receipt: resolved URL, HTTP
status, SHA-256 of retrieved bytes, retrieval timestamp, and a
verbatim quoted span with character offsets that DETERMINISTIC
NON-LLM CODE confirms is present in those bytes. No receipt, no row.

 V2  RESOLVED-AND-QUOTED — receipt present, quote grounded at
     offsets, and METADATA MATCH: retrieved record's own title, date
     and issuer match what the agent claimed.
     -> band magnitude unmodified.
 V1  RESOLVED — receipt present; quote grounding absent, or a
     non-critical metadata field mismatches.
     -> band magnitude REDUCED BY 2 LEVELS (e.g. +5 -> +3, +3 -> +1,
        +2 -> 0). Sign preserved.
 V0  UNRESOLVED — no receipt, or identifier is grammar-valid but does
     not resolve, or metadata mismatch on title/date/issuer.
     -> WEIGHT FORCED TO 0 dB. Row is RETAINED AND DISPLAYED,
        arithmetically inert. Format-valid-but-unresolvable is the
        hallucination signature; its RATE is published as fleet
        telemetry.
 VX  ADVERSARY-WRITABLE HOST — the content field is writable by
     unauthenticated or self-registered third parties (Wikimapia
     descriptions, OSM tags and changeset comments, Internet Archive
     uploaded items, forum post bodies, uploaded PDF text layers).
     -> POSITIVE bands forced to 0. May be cited as a LEAD.
        Identifiers appearing in VX text are LEADS, never citations:
        they must be independently resolved through the issuing
        authority's own interface before any row may cite them.

6.1  IDENTIFIER VALIDATION, in order, per source class: GRAMMAR ->
     RESOLUTION -> METADATA MATCH. Validators are required for at
     minimum: CREST CIA-RDP strings, DTIC AD numbers, NARA NAIDs, GAO
     report numbers, Federal Register citations, FCC ASR/ULS
     registrations, FPDS PIIDs / SAM contract IDs, FRUS
     volume+document pairs, USGS quad name+year, MSHA mine IDs,
     county parcel IDs, DOIs.
6.2  THE VERIFIER MUST BE DETERMINISTIC CODE OR A DIFFERENT MODEL
     FAMILY FROM THE DISCOVERER. An LLM verifying an LLM shares the
     priors that produced the error.
6.3  CACHE-AND-REVALIDATE, never cache-once. Store the content hash,
     re-fetch on schedule, alert on drift. A source that changes after
     being cited is a signal.

--------------------------------------------------------------
7. PROVENANCE — THREE ORTHOGONAL DIMENSIONS
--------------------------------------------------------------

v0.1 collapsed three different questions into one letter, and three
incompatible ladders already exist in the W0 registries. Split them.

7.1  INSTITUTIONAL ORIGIN (source_tier). A FOREIGN KEY into ONE
     versioned tier table with a per-source assignment for all 158
     catalogued sources. An agent may PROPOSE a source with a tier;
     the assignment is a reviewed write, never an inline judgement.
     Tier is set by the document's ORIGIN, never by its retrieval
     channel — a faithfully scanned P5 newsletter held in a P1
     archive is a P5 document with high retrieval integrity.

       P1 primary official (agency record, court record, filed
          permit, licence, deed, statute, appropriation)
       P2 primary derived (raw imagery, historical maps, registry
          extracts, procurement databases, faithful mirrors)
       P3 secondary rigorous (peer-reviewed; book with resolvable
          citations; investigative journalism with named sourcing)
       P4 secondary loose (enthusiast site, urbex documentation,
          unsourced press, wiki, compilation without resolvable
          primaries)
       P5 uncorroborated claim (forum post, video, anonymous
          testimony, self-published assertion)

     TIER CAPS ON BAND MAGNITUDE (the firewall, applied to EVERY
     observation on EVERY proposition, not to one axis):
       P1, P2  ->  |band| <= 5
       P3      ->  |band| <= 4
       P4      ->  |band| <= 2   (i.e. +/-7 dB)
       P5      ->  |band| <= 1   (i.e. +/-3 dB), and POSITIVE only if
                   the testimony passes the resolvability gate (9.3)

7.2  RETRIEVAL CHANNEL (archive_quality), recorded separately:
     ORIGIN-HOST / OFFICIAL-MIRROR / THIRD-PARTY-ARCHIVE /
     USER-UPLOAD. USER-UPLOAD implies VX.

7.3  CAUSAL PROVENANCE (causal_origin) — required, orthogonal:
       UNSOLICITED               no cap
       SOLICITED-BY-THIRD-PARTY  no cap
       SOLICITED-BY-CLAIMANT     POSITIVE bands forced to 0
       SELF-PUBLISHED            institutional tier forced to P4
                                 (a DOI that resolves is not an
                                 editorial assertion that resolves)
       CROWD-EDITED              VX; leads only, never a source

     THE GENERAL RULE: EVIDENCE CREATED AFTER, AND BECAUSE OF, THE
     CLAIM IS NOT EVIDENCE FOR THE CLAIM. This closes all four free
     .gov laundering channels at once — regulations.gov comments,
     FOIA no-records letters, self-minted DOIs, crowd-map edits.
     A FOIA response PDF is SPLIT: the restatement of the request is
     SOLICITED-BY-CLAIMANT and scores 0; the agency's substantive
     answer is UNSOLICITED content and is scored normally. A
     no-records response is scored ONLY through the expected-record
     table (section 8), never as positive evidence.

7.4  CORPUS ERA (required on every web source):
       PRE-2022-ATTESTED    independent archival snapshot dated
                            before 2022-11-30, or dated physical
                            publication -> no cap
       POST-2022-ATTESTED   named author with pre-2022 byline
                            history AND pre-2022 domain capture
                            history -> |band| <= 2
       SYNTHETIC-SUSPECT    post-2022, unbylined, no pre-2022 domain
                            history, or on the published
                            machine-generated-corpus blocklist
                            (Grokipedia, uapedia.ai, AI listicle
                            farms) -> 0 dB, 0 lineages, RETAINED AND
                            DISPLAYED

     WATERLINE RULE: a proposition whose entire POSITIVE support
     postdates 2022-11-30 and includes no verified pre-2022-dated
     document MAY NOT EXCEED GRADE D. For such claims the open
     corpus can no longer distinguish independent witnesses from
     regeneration, and the register says so.

7.5  SELF-EXCLUSION (hard constraint). The register keeps a complete
     timestamped log of everything it has published. Any source whose
     first observation postdates the register's own publication of
     that candidate is QUARANTINED: retained, displayed, 0 dB, 0
     lineages — unless it is a verified P1/P2 whose own DOCUMENT DATE
     precedes publication. A grade may RISE only on newly verified
     evidence carrying a pre-existing document date. Downward
     movement carries no such restriction. The asymmetry is
     deliberate: the failure mode is inflation.

--------------------------------------------------------------
8. ABSENCE OF EVIDENCE — THE EXPECTED-RECORD TABLE
--------------------------------------------------------------

A completed, RECEIPTED negative search is an observation. Its band is
set by the expected-record level X for that (record class x era x
agency funding authority x classification status). NOTHING ELSE in
the model can produce a negative from absence.

   X3  near-certain to exist AND be public if H is true   -> band -3 (-13 dB)
   X2  likely                                             -> band -2 ( -7 dB)
   X1  possible                                           -> band -1 ( -3 dB)
   X0  unlikely, or the record class is structurally
       absent / destroyed / never existed / withheld      -> band  0 (  0 dB)

An unsearched record class produces NO ROW — not a zero, an absence.

EXPECTED-RECORD TABLE v0.2.0 (seeded directly from the W0 registry
`gaps` sections; extensible by reviewed write):

 MILCON J-book line, appropriated agency, 1950-1990, unclassified  X3
 MILCON J-book line, project marked "Classified Project"           X0
 MILCON / appropriations, NON-APPROPRIATED entity (Federal
   Reserve, USPS, TVA, Farm Credit, FDIC)                          X0
 NIP/MIP-funded construction, any era                              X0
 FRPP entry, executive-agency facility, post-1998                  X2
 FRPP entry, national-security-withheld asset class                X0
 DoD Base Structure Report entry, acknowledged installation        X2
 FPDS/USAspending award naming the site, post-2008                 X1
   (contract descriptions are sanitised and miscoded; place of
    performance is frequently the contracting office)
 NEPA EIS filed with EPA, major federal action                     X2
 NEPA EA for facility-scale construction                           X1
   (no central index; most defence actions categorically excluded)
 NEPA, action on a federal installation away from jurisdictional
   waters                                                          X0
 Local building permit, federal construction on federal land       X0
 County deed, federal-to-federal transfer or land withdrawal       X0
 County deed, pre-1975 in a county digitised only to the 1990s     X0
 GSA disposal record, executive-agency real property               X2
 FCC ASR / ULS registration, COMMERCIAL emitter                    X3
 FCC ASR / ULS registration, FEDERAL emitter                       X0
   (federal spectrum is NTIA/IRAC, not FCC; GMF is withheld)
 NPRC personnel file, Army 1912-1960 or USAF 1947-1964             X0
   (12 July 1973 fire; ~80% / ~75% destroyed, no duplicates)
 USGS quad depiction, rural surface structure 1950-1980            X2
 USGS quad depiction where cartographic suppression is plausible   X1
 NRHP listing, restricted or sensitive feature                     X0
   (structurally excluded from the public spatial dataset)
 3DEP lidar coverage, remote federal land                          X1
 Chronicling America coverage, local press after 1963              X0
   (free corpus is copyright-bounded at ~1963)
 State well-driller report, well on federal land                   X0
 EPCRA Tier II, federal facility                                   X0
 CREST/DTIC declassified record, facility still classified         X0
 CREST/DTIC declassified record, facility declassified >25 yrs     X2
 Spoil-volume signature in imagery, excavation >1e5 m^3            X3
 Procurement trace for construction >$50M, appropriated agency     X3

8.1  THE ARGUMENT FROM SILENCE IS VALID ONLY WHERE THE SILENCE IS
     SURPRISING. This table is the entire mechanism, and it is the
     reason the Greenbrier in 1991 does not read as folklore and
     Mount Pony does not lose 40 points for being self-funded.

8.2  SEARCH COMPLETENESS INDEX
        SCI = (# X>=2 profiles with a receipted search) /
              (# X>=2 profiles applicable to this proposition)
     Published on every row. If SCI < 0.5 AND the grade would be
     D, E, F or R, the GRADE IS WITHHELD and the row displays
     "U — INSUFFICIENT SEARCH (SCI 0.33)" with the posterior shown.
     Grades A, B, C publish at any SCI: positive evidence does not
     require exhaustion, but a negative verdict does.

--------------------------------------------------------------
9. LINEAGE, CORROBORATION AND CONTAMINATION
--------------------------------------------------------------

There is no COR axis and no CONTAM multiplier. Independence is
enforced by DEDUPLICATION BEFORE SUMMATION.

9.1  SEMANTIC CLAIM CLUSTERING (not text overlap; not MinHash).
     Two observations share a LINEAGE if ANY of:
      (a) one cites the other, transitively;
      (b) they assert the same specific non-obvious particular — a
          number, codename, date, personal name, coordinate — that
          has a single traceable first appearance;
      (c) first-observation dating orders them and the later contains
          no particular absent from the earlier;
      (d) they were produced by AGENTS SHARING A BASE MODEL without
          independent retrieval receipts.
     Operative test: "would this source have produced this claim if
     the prior source had never existed?" If no -> same lineage.
     DEFAULT WHEN UNDECIDABLE: SAME LINEAGE.

9.2  ONE LINEAGE CONTRIBUTES AT MOST ONCE. Within a lineage, keep the
     single observation of largest |band|; discard the rest. Four
     hundred websites repeating one origin contribute once.
     CONTAMINATION THEREFORE REACHES THE FLOOR BY CONSTRUCTION: a
     claim whose every lineage collapses to one origin has one
     observation, and if that origin sits in channel 9 its positive
     contribution is 0, so the posterior equals the prior.

9.3  MODEL-FAMILY COLLAPSE. All findings from agents sharing a base
     model constitute ONE lineage, enforced in the schema. AGENT
     INDEPENDENCE IS NOT SOURCE INDEPENDENCE and contributes nothing.
     High inter-agent agreement on UNVERIFIED assertions is a
     shared-prior signature and is logged as such.

9.4  COMPILER TRANSPARENCY. A compiler that exposes its primaries is
     a CONDUIT, not a lineage terminus: if at least one cited primary
     resolves under VERIFIER, the PRIMARIES are pulled and scored as
     their own lineages and the compiler scores nothing. If none
     resolves, the compiler is one P4 lineage terminus. A critical
     edition citing forty primary documents is forty lineages.

9.5  TESTIMONY RESOLVABILITY GATE. A named account contributes
     positively only if the individual is independently locatable in
     a record that (i) PREDATES the claim and (ii) was created for an
     unrelated purpose — payroll, unit history, union roll, obituary,
     court filing, property record. A name that resolves to nothing
     outside the claim contributes 0. Statements by resolvable named
     persons DENYING the claim are scored normally and negatively.

9.6  FACT-KEY MERGING. Observations asserting the same underlying
     real-world fact carry the same fact_key and are merged: keep the
     strongest, then add +3 dB per ADDITIONAL INDEPENDENT LINEAGE
     asserting that same fact, to a maximum of +6 dB. This is what
     stops one fact ("this was an AT&T Long Lines station") entering
     four times through four different record types.

9.7  CITOGENESIS. When a P4/P5 claim is later cited by a P3+ source
     that itself cites only the P4/P5, the whole loop is ONE lineage
     and the laundered observation's weight is set to 0 with a
     published flag. It does not merely get "flagged loudly."

9.8  PROPOSITION ROUTING. Every source is bound to the proposition it
     supports. Project Gasbuggy supports {an underground nuclear test
     occurred at coordinates X in 1967}. It is NOT an observation on
     {an alien base exists under Archuleta Mesa} and is excluded from
     that ledger entirely, visibly. PROXIMITY IS NOT SUPPORT.

--------------------------------------------------------------
10. EVIDENCE CHANNELS AND CAPS
--------------------------------------------------------------

Each observation routes to EXACTLY ONE channel, determined by the
ARTIFACT CLASS OF THE SOURCE, never by the content of the inference.

     records, filed permits,
     licences, statutes, courts)          +40
  2  FISCAL (appropriations, MILCON,

  3  PROPERTY (title, deeds, real

  4  GEOSPATIAL-SURFACE (maps,

  5  SUBSURFACE-ENGINEERING (mine

  6  UTILITY-SIGNATURE (power, comms,

     PRESS                                +13

     literature, video, aggregators)        0   <- negative only

10.1 PLACE-DERIVED AGGREGATE CAP. Channels 4 + 5 + 6 combined may
     contribute at most:
        +13 dB  to P3, P4, P5, P6, P8
        +20 dB  to P1, P2, P7
     Consequence, computed: for a sensitive P5 at RC3 (prior -25),
     place-derived signals alone top out at -12 dB = P 0.06 = GRADE F.
     NO COMBINATION OF TERRAIN AND INFRASTRUCTURE CAN EVER CARRY A
     FUNCTION CLAIM ABOVE F. Choosing a good-looking location buys
     the fabricator nothing.

10.2 NEGATIVE CONTRIBUTIONS ARE UNCAPPED, in every channel. The
     asymmetry is deliberate and stated publicly.

10.3 THE ENTRY PAGE RENDERS TWO BARS PER PROPOSITION:
     PLACE-DERIVED (ch 4,5,6) and CLAIM-DERIVED (ch 1,2,3,7,8).
     A reader must be able to see at a glance how much of a grade is
     the mountain and how much is the claim.

--------------------------------------------------------------
11. GRADE BANDS (posterior probability; labels and math agree)
--------------------------------------------------------------

 Grade   L_post (dB)     P            Label
 -----   -----------     ----------   --------------------------------
   A     >= +20          >= 0.990     ESTABLISHED
   B     +13 to +20      0.952-0.990  STRONGLY EVIDENCED

   D     0 to +7         0.500-0.834  OPEN — more likely than not
   E     -7 to 0         0.166-0.500  DOUBTFUL — claim exists,
                                      evidence does not favour it
   F     -17 to -7       0.020-0.166  UNSUPPORTED
   R     < -17           < 0.020      REFUTED (gated, see 11.1)

11.1 R IS GATED ON EVIDENCE, NOT ON THE POSTERIOR. R requires
     L_post < -17 AND (>= 1 observation at band <= -4 OR >= 2
     observations at band <= -3). Without that, the row is
     "F (PRIOR-DOMINATED)" however low the number. F and R are
     opposite epistemic states — no evidence either way versus
     affirmative disconfirmation — and the register never conflates
     them.
11.2 U — INSUFFICIENT SEARCH replaces the grade when SCI < 0.5 and
     the grade would be D/E/F/R (section 8.2).
11.3 CAPS that override the band: unnamed H_alt -> max D (2.3);
     post-2022-only support -> max D (7.4); no verified instance-level
     source naming the function -> P5 max D (falls out of 5.2).
11.4 NOTHING IS DELETED. F and R rows are retained with their origin
     documented and their refuting sources cited.

--------------------------------------------------------------
12. RECORD QUALITY Q — PUBLISHED SEPARATELY, NEVER IN THE MATH
--------------------------------------------------------------

 Q4 DOCUMENTARY   >= 1 verified P1/P2 instance-level record on whose
                  face the proposition rests

 Q2 INFERENTIAL   carried by matrix-band observations only (|band|<=3)
 Q1 TESTIMONIAL   carried by resolvable testimony only
 Q0 CLAIMED       nothing verified; posterior equals the prior

Every proposition publishes as:
    P5[COG/COOP]:  P = 0.995  (A · ESTABLISHED)
                   record quality Q4 DOCUMENTARY
                   H_alt: A08 ordinary above-ground gov't building
                   search completeness 7/9
                   place-derived +0 dB · claim-derived +46 dB
                   80% interval  L = +26 to +40  (grade A to A)

This is the historian's "two numbers," and it is why the Fairview,
Kansas station publishes P(HARDENED)=0.9975 grade A at record quality
Q3 rather than being demoted to C for lacking a federal document.

--------------------------------------------------------------
13. UNCERTAINTY, SCORER RELIABILITY, AND GRADE MOVEMENT
--------------------------------------------------------------

13.1 Per-observation band uncertainty is +/-1 level; the modal step
     between adjacent bands is ~5 dB, so sigma_obs = 3 dB.
     sigma_prior = 3 dB.
        sigma_L = sqrt(9 * n_eff + 9),  n_eff = contributing
                                        observations after dedup
     Publish the 80% interval L +/- 1.28 * sigma_L, mapped to P and
     to grades. Publish the GRADE SPAN, never a bare letter.
13.2 Every proposition row pins scorer_model_id, rubric_version,
     prior_table_version, expected_record_table_version. No grade may
     be compared across scorer versions without re-scoring the
     baseline.
13.3 Blind double-score a rolling 10% sample with a DIFFERENT MODEL
     FAMILY. Publish Krippendorff's alpha on the ordinal band
     assignments as standing methodology telemetry. Ordinal bands
     make this computable; continuous 0-100 axes did not.
13.4 TRANSITION CAUSE VOCABULARY (required on every re-grade):
     NEW-VERIFIED-EVIDENCE / NEW-DISCLOSURE / REFUTATION /
     SEARCH-COMPLETED / CLASS-DENOMINATOR-CHANGE / RESOLVER-MERGE /
     RESOLVER-SPLIT / PRIOR-REVISION / SCORER-CHANGE / RESCORE-NOISE /
     REGISTER-ECHO / CLAMP.
13.5 SUPPRESSION RULE: no movement smaller than 1 * sigma_L is
     rendered on the public confidence chart, and movements with
     cause SCORER-CHANGE, RESCORE-NOISE, PRIOR-REVISION or
     REGISTER-ECHO are rendered in a visually distinct style and
     excluded from the evidence narrative. NEW-DISCLOSURE is rendered
     distinctly from NEW-VERIFIED-EVIDENCE: the Greenbrier's 1992 jump
     is a publication event, not a change in the world.

--------------------------------------------------------------
14. ENTITY RESOLUTION
--------------------------------------------------------------

14.1 entity_level enum {program, site, structure} with parent-child
     relations, plus an explicit DISTINCT-FROM relation seeded from
     the calibration set (Manzano Base vs KUMMSC is asserted apart in
     the schema and can never be silently re-merged).
14.2 A MERGE REQUIRES a named, VERIFIED, INSTANCE-LEVEL source
     asserting the identity. Coordinate proximity and name similarity
     are grounds to FLAG a possible duplicate — never to merge.
14.3 EVIDENCE DOES NOT POOL ON MERGE. Every observation stays bound
     to the specific entity its source names. If a merge raises a
     posterior, the merge is doing evidentiary work it has not
     justified and is rejected.
14.4 Merges and splits are versioned, reversible events with their
     justifying source attached. Merge/split rates are fleet
     telemetry; a rising merge rate is an entity-resolution failure
     signature.

--------------------------------------------------------------

--------------------------------------------------------------

15.1 P7 LOCATION below grade C at the stated precision renders as a

15.2 Every entry emits a machine-readable provenance beacon so
     downstream reuse is attributable and the register can measure
     its own footprint in the corpus.
15.3 The entry page leads with the proposition table, the H_alt
     disposition table, and the lineage graph. The composite is not

  Obs 6 · ch8 LOCAL RECORD · 1950s Gettysburg-area press on the excavation. For FUNCTION: E2 / A2 → 0 dB.

worked_examples.name: 33 Thomas Street, Manhattan (AT&T Long Lines Building / TITANPOINTE) — the urban / in-building test
worked_examples.walkthrough:
This is the case that proved v0.1's GEO axis encoded a buried-rural-mountain prior: 33 Thomas could not clear grade B because adits, spoil and terrain are inapplicable to a Manhattan tower. In DECIBAN there are no axes to be null. An inapplicable signal class simply generates NO OBSERVATION, and the expected-record profile for 'USGS quad adit symbol at RC4' is X0, so the negative search contributes 0 dB rather than a zero score.

Reference class RC4 (purpose-built critical-infrastructure structure — a telephone exchange; its ordinary commercial identity is not in dispute).

P3 HARDENED. Prior (RC4) = -7 dB. H_alt: A07 ordinary windowless telecom switching building, robust but not hardened.
  Obs 1 · ch1 · P1 · V2 · INSTANCE · AT&T's own published engineering literature and NYC Department of Buildings filings specifying a structure designed to survive atomic attack and remain self-sufficient. Gate: all six conditions met → BAND +5 = +40 dB.
  Obs 2 · ch1 · Warnecke architectural record, independent lineage, same fact_key → +3 dB confirmation.
  Obs 3 · ch6 UTILITY · fuel storage, generator permits, water. E3 / A2 (a large telco switch has these too) → 0 dB. Correctly inert.
  Obs 4 · ch4 GEOSPATIAL · negative search for adit/spoil/terrain signature. Expected-record X0 at RC4 → 0 dB. NO PENALTY.
  L_post = -7 + 40 + 3 + 0 + 0 = +36 dB → P = 0.99975 → GRADE A, Q4.

P5 FUNCTION[SIGINT collection / international gateway]. Prior (RC4, sensitive) = -20 dB. H_alt: A07.
  Obs 1 · ch1 · P3 · V2 · The Intercept, November 2016, publishing NSA documents identifying TITANPOINTE with this building. The issuing body (a news organisation) lacks direct authority over the fact, so condition (d) fails → BAND +4 = +20 dB (P3 tier cap is |band| 4; not binding).
  Obs 2 · ch1 · P1 · FCC international-carrier records and AT&T route literature establishing the building as a major international gateway switch. Distinct fact_key. E3 / A1 (an ordinary exchange is rarely an international gateway) → band +1 = +3 dB... but this source EXPLICITLY states the gateway function at instance level from an authority → band +4 gate applies, capped by ch1 headroom → +20 dB. Take the conservative reading actually required by 5.2(c): the FCC record states 'international gateway', not 'collection site', so it evidences a DIFFERENT proposition. Score it at the matrix value for the SIGINT proposition: E3/A1 → +3 dB, and open a separate P5[international-gateway-switch] row where it gates at +4.
  Obs 3 · ch8 · named-source reporting on the building's visitor and access arrangements consistent with a partner-agency presence. E2 / A1 → band +1 = +3 dB.
  L_post = -20 + 20 + 3 + 3 = +6 dB → P = 0.799.
  n_eff = 3 → sigma_L = 6.0 → interval -1.7 to +13.7 dB → P 0.40 to 0.96.
  GRADE D · OPEN · record quality Q3 · flagged PRIOR-SENSITIVE (break-even 1 dB).

P5 FUNCTION[international gateway switch]: prior -7 (mundane), obs 2 at +20, obs from AT&T route literature +3 → L = +16 dB → P = 0.975 → GRADE B, Q4.

RESULT AND WHAT IT SHOWS: existence A, hardening A, gateway function B, SIGINT-collection function D. This is precisely 'THE HOLE IS CERTAIN, THE FUNCTION IS NOT' — and it is expressed for an above-ground urban building without any typology-conditional weight vector, because the model never had axes to make inapplicable in the first place. Note also the honesty: the SIGINT attribution rests on one document lineage, and D says so rather than laundering it up on the strength of the building.

answers_to_fatals:
POINT BY POINT AGAINST ALL EIGHT ESTABLISHED FATALS, THE SIX ADDITIONAL FATALS FROM THE ADVERSARIAL SKEPTIC, AND THE MAJORS. Where the model does not resolve something, it says so.

--- THE EIGHT ESTABLISHED FATALS ---

1. EVIDENCE HAS NO SIGN — RESOLVED. Bands run -5 to +5 and negative bands enter the same sum. REFUTER's numeric hook is band -5 (-40 dB): a verified record documenting the fabrication or misattribution of a claim's origin. Disconfirmation is distinguishable from absence in three ways: (a) an unsearched record class produces NO ROW at all, (b) a searched-and-empty record class produces a row whose weight comes from the expected-record table and may legitimately be 0 dB, (c) affirmative disconfirmation produces a negative band. Grade R is GATED ON THE PRESENCE of a band <= -4 or two at band <= -3, so 'refuted' can never be confused with 'nobody looked' — a low posterior with no negative observation publishes as 'F (PRIOR-DOMINATED)'. The Dulce AFOSI documentation moved from +DOC to -40 dB.

2. UNIT ERROR (grades a place, evidence attaches to a proposition) — RESOLVED. Section 1: a site is a container, only propositions are graded, every observation is bound to exactly one proposition, and section 9.8 (proposition routing) excludes off-proposition sources from the ledger visibly rather than silently crediting them. Project Gasbuggy is excluded from the Dulce ledger with a stated reason. Camp Hero publishes A on the radar station and R on the Montauk Project at the same coordinates.

3. NO DIAGNOSTICITY — RESOLVED, and it is the model's spine rather than a coefficient bolted on. Every inferential observation is scored as 10*log10(P(obs|H)/P(obs|H_alt)) through the 4x4 E/A matrix against a MANDATORY NAMED alternative. Ventilation shafts, spoil, road grade, deep wells, rail spurs and dedicated substations all land on E3/A3 = 0 dB against A02 and are published as contributing nothing, by name, on the entry page. The 54%-of-weight problem is gone because there are no weights: there are channels with caps, and channels 4+5+6 combined are capped at +13 dB for any proposition other than existence, extent and location.

4. ARITHMETIC CONTRADICTION (conclusive primary document → grade E) — RESOLVED, and resolved without an override. Band +5 = +40 dB. The worst prior in the table is -25 dB. -25 + 40 = +15 dB = P 0.969 = GRADE B. A conclusive primary source naming facility, location and function therefore cannot land below B from any starting point. Because grade bands are defined on posterior probability and the labels describe probability states ('ESTABLISHED', 'STRONGLY EVIDENCED', 'PROBABLE', 'OPEN', 'DOUBTFUL', 'UNSUPPORTED', 'REFUTED'), the prose and the mathematics are the same instrument. Evidence KIND is published separately as record quality Q, which is where 'documentary vs testimonial vs inferential' properly lives.

5. CONFIDENCE-IN-EVIDENCE PUBLISHED AS EXISTENCE / NO EXPECTED-RECORD PRIOR — RESOLVED. Two numbers per proposition: P (posterior probability, with interval) and Q (ordinal record quality), never merged. The expected-record table (section 8), seeded directly from the W0 registries' own `gaps` sections, sets the weight of every negative search: X0 profiles contribute exactly 0 dB. Greenbrier 1991 publishes EXISTS B / FUNCTION[COG] F with three record classes searched and all three returning X0. Mount Pony loses nothing for being non-appropriated. The argument from silence fires only where the silence is surprising, and the table says where that is.

6. CONTAM FLOORS AT x0.5, F UNREACHABLE — RESOLVED. There is no multiplier. Negative contributions are uncapped in every channel. SubTropolis reaches -56 dB, Louisville Mega Cavern's COG proposition -65 dB, Dulce -124 dB. The floor is gone because the mechanism that created it is gone.

7. COR COUNTS SOURCES AND CALLS IT INDEPENDENCE; THE FLEET MANUFACTURES FALSE CORROBORATION — RESOLVED. There is no COR. Corroboration is the arithmetic addition of independent lineages, after: semantic claim clustering (9.1, clustering on the ASSERTION not the wording, so paraphrase collapses into its parent), one-contribution-per-lineage (9.2), MODEL-FAMILY COLLAPSE enforced in the schema (9.3 — all findings from agents sharing a base model are ONE lineage), compiler transparency (9.4), fact-key merging with a +6 dB confirmation ceiling (9.6), corpus-era tagging with SYNTHETIC-SUSPECT at 0 dB and 0 lineages (7.4), and self-exclusion against the register's own publication log (7.5). The claim that agent blindness produces source independence is deleted and its inverse is stated: high agreement on unverified assertions is a shared-prior signature and is logged as such.

8. GEO ENCODES A BURIED-RURAL-MOUNTAIN PRIOR — RESOLVED STRUCTURALLY. There are no axes to be inapplicable. A signal class that does not apply generates no observation; a searched-and-absent class is looked up in the expected-record table, where 'USGS quad adit symbol at RC4' is X0 and contributes 0 dB. 33 Thomas Street grades A on EXISTS and A on HARDENED with zero geospatial contribution and no typology-conditional weight vector anywhere in the model.

--- THE ADVERSARIAL SKEPTIC'S SIX FATALS ---

9. NO VERIFICATION TIER — RESOLVED AS A SCHEMA CONSTRAINT (section 6). Resolve-or-die receipts: URL, HTTP status, SHA-256, timestamp, verbatim span at character offsets confirmed by deterministic non-LLM code. Identifier grammar validators then resolution then METADATA MATCH for at least twelve identifier classes. Tier V0-UNRESOLVED contributes 0 dB and is retained and displayed; the format-valid-but-unresolvable RATE is published as fleet telemetry and is the direct measurement of how much of the register is imaginary. The verifier must be deterministic code or a different model family. Note the incentive gradient is now INVERTED relative to v0.1: the highest bands (+/-4, +/-5) require the strictest verification, so the easiest identifier to hallucinate is also the one that buys the most and is checked the hardest.

10. TYPOLOGY EXCLUDED FROM SCORING — RESOLVED. Typology is P5, a graded proposition with its own prior, its own ledger, its own named alternative and its own badge. Default is `unknown-anomaly` with no row. Sensitive typologies start at -20 to -25 dB. Relabelling is not an edit; it is opening a proposition at a hostile prior with an empty ledger. Louisville Mega Cavern publishes A on the shelter designation and R on COG on the same page, which is the ratified regression test.

11. CHEAPEST PATH TO B COSTS ZERO AND FABRICATES NOTHING — RESOLVED BY THE PLACE-DERIVED CAP (10.1). Channels 4+5+6 combined contribute at most +13 dB to P3, P4, P5, P6 and P8. From the RC3 sensitive prior of -25, place-derived signals alone top out at -12 dB = P 0.06 = GRADE F. Recomputing the skeptic's own attack: v0.1's firewall ceiling was 83.20 = B on nothing but blogs and forum posts; here the equivalent construction — P4/P5 sources only, tier caps |band| 2 and 1, place-derived aggregate capped — cannot exceed grade D on any function proposition. Target selection buys nothing because the mountain is capped and the two contributions are rendered as separate bars on every entry page.

12. SHARED MODEL PRIORS INVERT CONTAM AND INFLATE COR SIMULTANEOUSLY — RESOLVED by 9.3 model-family collapse enforced in the schema rather than in an agent's judgement, plus 9.1(d), plus the requirement to run a sample through genuinely different model families and publish inter-family agreement as telemetry. Seven agents on one base model are one lineage and contribute once. Because there is no CONTAM term to be driven low, there is nothing left to invert.

13. CONTAM DETECTS COPYING; LLM CONTAMINATION IS REGENERATION — RESOLVED. Lineage clustering is SEMANTIC, on the assertion, not on the wording (9.1(b),(c)) — MinHash and shingle overlap are explicitly abandoned. Corpus-era tagging (7.4) makes post-2022 unbylined web text SYNTHETIC-SUSPECT at 0 dB and 0 lineages, with a versioned public blocklist. The PRE-2022 EVIDENTIARY WATERLINE caps any claim at grade D whose entire positive support postdates 2022-11-30 without a verified pre-2022 document. Self-exclusion (7.5) quarantines the register's own echo, and a grade may rise only on evidence carrying a pre-existing document date, which is the only defence that does not depend on detecting derivation.

14. THE DOC FIREWALL IS BREACHED FOR FREE THROUGH LEGITIMATE .GOV CHANNELS — RESOLVED by CAUSAL PROVENANCE (7.3), orthogonal to institutional tier. SOLICITED-BY-CLAIMANT forces positive bands to 0; a FOIA PDF is split so that the agency's answer is scored and the requester's restatement of the facility name is not; SELF-PUBLISHED (including self-minted DOIs) forces tier P4 and requires a resolving editorial assertion, not a resolving DOI; CROWD-EDITED is VX, leads only, so OSM and Wikimapia are excluded from scoring entirely while remaining visible as discovery pointers. The general rule is stated once and closes all four channels: evidence created after, and because of, the claim is not evidence for the claim.

--- THE MAJORS ---

15. PROMPT INJECTION / CACHE-ONCE — RESOLVED IN THE MODEL'S SCOPE. VX forces adversary-writable hosts to 0 positive dB; identifiers appearing in VX text are LEADS requiring independent resolution through the issuing authority's own interface before any row may cite them (6, 6.1), which defeats the dangerous WEAK version of the attack where the agent merely repeats a well-formed identifier. Cache-and-revalidate replaces cache-once (6.3): content hash stored, re-fetch on schedule, alert on drift. Every source records whether its host is adversary-writable and that is surfaced on the entry page. NOT RESOLVED BY THE SCORING MODEL: the structural data/instruction boundary in the ingestion prompts and the CI injection red-team suite are pipeline requirements, listed in agent_implications.

16. SCORER NOISE EXCEEDS BAND WIDTH — SUBSTANTIALLY RESOLVED, HONESTLY BOUNDED. Every quantity is a lookup, an enum, or a four-level ordinal with written anchors; there is not one continuous parameter in the model. Uncertainty is computed and PUBLISHED (13.1) rather than assumed away: sigma_L = sqrt(9*n_eff + 9), 80% interval rendered, grade SPAN published rather than a bare letter. Movements smaller than 1 sigma are suppressed from the confidence chart; SCORER-CHANGE, RESCORE-NOISE, PRIOR-REVISION and REGISTER-ECHO are in the transition vocabulary, rendered distinctly, and excluded from the evidence narrative. Scorer model ID and all three table versions are pinned per row. Blind double-scoring at 10% with a different family, with Krippendorff's alpha published — computable precisely because bands are ordinal. HONEST RESIDUAL: sigma is typically 6-8 dB against 7 dB bands, so band-edge instability persists. It is now measured, disclosed and rendered, not eliminated.

17. THREE INCOMPATIBLE P-TIER LADDERS ALREADY IN W0 OUTPUT — RESOLVED. Section 7 splits the one letter into three orthogonal dimensions (institutional origin / retrieval channel / causal origin), and source_tier becomes a FOREIGN KEY into ONE versioned table with a per-source assignment for all 158 catalogued sources. An agent may propose; the assignment is a reviewed write. Tier is set by the document's ORIGIN, never by its retrieval channel, so a P5 newsletter faithfully scanned in a P1 archive is a P5 document with high archive quality — which resolves the Black Vault / governmentattic / GlobalSecurity / Internet Archive collisions by construction.

18. RESOLVER AS A SCORE-LAUNDERING PRIMITIVE — RESOLVED (section 14). Merges require a named verified instance-level source asserting identity; proximity and name similarity FLAG only; evidence does not pool because every observation stays bound to the entity its source names; a merge that raises a posterior is rejected as doing unjustified evidentiary work; merges and splits are versioned and reversible; entity_level {program, site, structure} plus an explicit DISTINCT-FROM relation seeded from the calibration set holds Manzano Base and KUMMSC apart permanently.

19. REGISTER BECOMES ITS OWN SOURCE — RESOLVED by 7.5 self-exclusion, the upward-movement asymmetry, the provenance beacon, and REGISTER-ECHO in the transition vocabulary. The loop is published on the methodology page.

20. NON-APPROPRIATED / QUASI-GOVERNMENTAL BLIND SPOT — RESOLVED by making agency funding authority a key of the expected-record table. Mount Pony grades A. The coverage map is published rather than implied.

--- WHERE THIS MODEL DOES NOT RESOLVE THE CRITIQUES ---

(a) A WELL-EXECUTED FORGERY that resolves, quotes and matches metadata passes every gate. Verification stops at 'the bytes exist and say this'. The model has no defence and does not pretend to; the canary programme measures confabulation, not forgery.
(b) THE CANARY PROGRAMME, the injection red-team suite, the data/instruction boundary and the CI regression harness are PIPELINE requirements. The scoring model cannot supply them and none of them is optional.
(c) CALIBRATION IS ASSERTED, NOT DEMONSTRATED. Publishing 'P = 0.995' implies a frequency claim the register cannot yet support. The mitigation is bands, intervals, published sensitivity, and the label 'model posterior'. It is a real weakness for the first several hundred adjudications.
(d) DIA under this model returns R on the hardened-facility proposition where the IC analyst's calibration set expected E. Two bands. I believe R is correct once the entry is split (P1 EXISTS on the underground works grades A, and the analyst's E was reasoning inside a system that could not split), but it is a DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE from a ratified expectation and must be adjudicated at ratification rather than silently absorbed.
(e) Fairview KS returns A where the analyst expected B, for the reason given in that worked example — the divergence is P-versus-Q and is intentional. Within one band.
agent_implications:
WHAT DECIBAN DEMANDS THAT THE CURRENT FLEET DOES NOT SUPPLY. Seven of these are new capabilities, not new instructions; four of them are hard blockers on W1.

1. VERIFIER — A NEW TIER BETWEEN DISCOVERY AND ADJUDICATION, AND IT MUST NOT BE AN LLM OF THE DISCOVERER'S FAMILY. Nothing in the fleet resolves a citation to bytes today. Every band in this model except 0 depends on a retrieval receipt, and bands +/-4 and +/-5 — the only bands that can carry a grade above C — depend on quote-grounding at character offsets plus a metadata match on title, date and issuer. This is deterministic code: a fetcher, a hasher, a substring locator, and twelve-plus identifier grammar validators (CREST CIA-RDP, DTIC AD, NARA NAID, GAO report numbers, Federal Register cites, FCC ASR/ULS, FPDS PIID / SAM contract IDs, FRUS volume+document, USGS quad name+year, MSHA mine ID, county parcel ID, DOI). W1 MUST NOT RUN UNTIL THIS EXISTS, because without it every source enters at V0 and every proposition equals its prior. Note the environment constraint the W0 registries already documented: three of five were built with .gov egress blocked. VERIFIER needs working egress to the origin hosts or the register cannot score anything above D.

2. A NEGATIVE-SEARCH AGENT (call it NULLIFIER). This model needs RECEIPTED ABSENCE as first-class data, and no agent in the fleet produces it. For every proposition, NULLIFIER enumerates the applicable expected-record profiles, executes each search, and writes a row recording the query, the endpoint, the timestamp, the empty result, and the X level from the table. Three consequences: the search-completeness index becomes computable, grade F and R become licensable (you may not declare a claim unsupported without having looked), and the IC analyst's null-return requirement is satisfied as a by-product because null returns are now the model's fuel rather than an unrewarded chore.

3. PRIOR-KEEPER — a maintainer role with no analogue in the current fleet. It owns three versioned tables (priors, expected-record profiles, source tiers), computes the class-evidence denominator M on every candidate write, runs the re-derivation every 50 resolved A/R propositions, and publishes the arithmetic. The M-count in particular is a standing bookkeeping obligation: adding a candidate hilltop dilutes the prior of every other candidate competing for the same documented program slots, and nothing in the current design would notice.

4. REFUTER IS PROMOTED FROM COMMENTATOR TO CO-SCORER, AND ITS BRIEF CHANGES. It must (a) name H_alt from the enumerated set per proposition, (b) justify why it is the strongest surviving alternative, (c) assign the A-level for EVERY observation in the ledger — half of every likelihood ratio in the model is REFUTER's output — and (d) run on grades A and C through R rather than only above C. Its 'defaults to refuted under uncertainty' prior is DELETED and replaced by the prior table, which is typology- and reference-class-conditional and published. REFUTER no longer needs a blanket bias because the model gives it a numeric channel: bands -3 to -5.

5. LINEAGE'S IMPLEMENTATION CHANGES ENTIRELY. MinHash shingling and citation-graph traversal cannot cluster regenerated text and must be replaced by CLAIM-LEVEL SEMANTIC CLUSTERING on the assertion, with first-observation dating as tiebreaker and 'same lineage' as the default under uncertainty. It additionally acquires four new jobs the current design has no hook for: model-family collapse, corpus-era tagging from independent archival snapshots plus domain registration history, self-exclusion against the register's own publication log, and the compiler-transparency test (pull the compiler's primaries; if any resolves, score the primaries and discard the compiler).

6. ASSESSOR'S OUTPUT SHAPE IS DIFFERENT AND SMALLER. It no longer invents six numbers. Per observation it emits: proposition_id, channel, fact_key, E-level, A-level, and — where a gate is claimed — which of the six gate conditions are satisfied. Everything else is a lookup or arithmetic. This is the single largest reduction in required judgement in the redesign, and it is the reason the model is applicable at scale: the agent is asked 'how expected is this if the claim is true, and if the mine explanation is true', never 'what is GEO out of 100'.

7. CANARY — continuous injection of rotating fabricated facility names with zero corpus presence into the discovery queue. Any citation returned for a canary is a directly measured hallucination against known ground truth. Publish the rate. This converts the largest unquantified risk in the project into a monitored number and is cheap.

8. A SECOND MODEL FAMILY, AS A HARD ARCHITECTURAL REQUIREMENT. Needed in two places that cannot be served by the same weights: VERIFIER (an LLM verifying an LLM shares the priors that produced the error) and the 10% blind double-scoring sample that produces the published inter-rater agreement. If only one family is available, the register must publish that it has no independent verification and cap accordingly.

9. HARVESTER CHANGES: cache-and-revalidate rather than cache-once; content hashes stored and diffed on a schedule with drift alerts; an adversary-writable flag per host; all fetched text entering the pipeline as structurally bounded DATA, never as free prose in a scoring prompt; identifiers extracted from untrusted text routed to a leads table, never to a citations table.

10. SCHEMA OBLIGATIONS BEFORE FREEZE, because every one of these is a migration rather than an addition if deferred: propositions as first-class rows with a parent relation; observations bound to exactly one proposition; entity_level {program, site, structure} plus DISTINCT-FROM; source_tier as a foreign key into the curated table; the three orthogonal provenance dimensions; retrieval receipts; lineage IDs; fact_keys; the register's own publication log; scorer/rubric/table version pinning per grade row; and the transition-cause vocabulary. Status gains PROPOSED, STUDIED, CANCELLED, NEVER-BUILT; location precision gains NON-LOCATED.

11. WHAT THE REGISTRIES ALREADY GIVE US, AND SHOULD BE MINED IMMEDIATELY: the five W0 `gaps` sections are the raw material for the expected-record table and I have seeded roughly thirty rows directly from them — the NPRC fire, the FCC-versus-NTIA split, FRPP's national-security exclusion, NRHP's sensitive-feature exclusion, the categorical-exclusion hole in NEPA, the 1963 copyright waterline in Chronicling America, federal-land wells exempt from state permitting, federal construction exempt from local permitting, federal-to-federal transfers generating no deed. That table is the highest-value artifact the W0 work produced and nothing in v0.1 could use it.

12. A COMBINED THREE-LENS REGRESSION SUITE IN CI BEFORE SCHEMA FREEZE, with the pairs treated as load-bearing: Mega Cavern (shelter A / COG R), Kirtland (Manzano and KUMMSC never merged), Camp Hero (station A / Montauk R), Cheyenne Mountain (existence A / current-NORAD-HQ status R), Greenbrier (1991 EXISTS B + FUNCTION F, 1993 both A, transition cause NEW-DISCLOSURE), SubTropolis (storage A / hardened R), Fairview (hardened A at Q3), DUCC (program A / exists R), Dulce (R with origin retained). Plus the three tests that are not about facilities at all and that measure the pipeline rather than the model: the fabricated CREST identifier must resolve to V0 and contribute 0 dB; the rotating canary must return nothing; and the self-citation ratchet simulated against a staging corpus must produce no upward movement.
tradeoffs:
HONEST WEAKNESSES, AND WHAT THIS MODEL STILL CANNOT EXPRESS.

1. CONDITIONAL INDEPENDENCE IS ASSUMED AND IS FALSE. Adding decibans presumes observations are independent given the hypothesis. After lineage deduplication and fact-key merging they are less correlated, but they are not independent — a facility that generates a MILCON line also tends to generate a NEPA filing and a contract award, and those three are correlated through 'this project was visible to the appropriated-agency records system'. Channel caps are a crude correction. The practical consequence is that dB sums RUN HOT on evidence-rich candidates, which is why several worked examples land at P > 0.999 where an honest posterior might be 0.99. Mitigation: the caps, the +6 dB confirmation ceiling on fact-key merges, and never publishing more than three significant figures. Residual risk: real.

2. THE E/A MATRIX HAS SIXTEEN CELLS AND REALITY HAS MORE. Genuinely intermediate diagnosticity — a signal that is somewhat more expected under H than under H_alt but not clearly one band — is unrepresentable, and round-toward-zero pushes such cases to 0 dB. This systematically UNDER-counts weak positive evidence. That is the direction I chose deliberately (the failure mode this project fears is inflation), but it means a candidate supported by many genuinely weak-but-real signals will grade lower than a Bayesian with continuous likelihoods would say. The Nike Hercules magazine class — real, ordinary, well-attested at class level and thin at instance level — is where this will bite most often.

3. THE PRIOR TABLE IS THE SOFTEST COMPONENT AND REFERENCE-CLASS ASSIGNMENT IS A JUDGEMENT. Is the Greenbrier RC5 (a resort on private land) or RC4 (a purpose-built critical-infrastructure structure)? That single choice is worth 12 dB on the hardening proposition. I mitigated with 'take the lowest prior when ambiguous' and with published break-even sensitivity, but I did not eliminate it, and reference-class assignment is exactly the kind of judgement the brief warns will never actually be received at scale. It should be the first thing measured in the double-scoring sample.

4. PUBLISHING PROBABILITIES IMPLIES A CALIBRATION THE REGISTER CANNOT DEMONSTRATE. 'P = 0.995' invites the reader to believe that of a thousand such claims, five are false. The register will have no evidence for that until hundreds of propositions have resolved to A or R by independent means. Bands, intervals and the label 'model posterior' help; they do not make the number a frequency. A reader determined to over-read it will succeed.

5. NEGATIVE EVIDENCE IS UNCAPPED, SO THE MODEL IS EASY TO DRIVE TO R. Two band -3 observations plus a hostile prior reaches R. A lazy or over-confident REFUTER, or a wrong H_alt that happens to explain everything, will produce false refutations, and the register's characteristic failure mode under this model is therefore the FALSE NEGATIVE — quietly refuting a real facility whose mundane cover story is good. The Greenbrier's Forsythe Associates arrangement is the archetype: a well-constructed cover produces exactly the observation pattern that drives the function proposition to F. I accept this asymmetry deliberately, but the register must publish its R-rate and its R-reversal rate as standing telemetry, and any R that rests entirely on expected-record negatives with no affirmative disconfirmation should be reviewed on a schedule.

6. THE MODEL CANNOT EXPRESS DISJUNCTIVE EXISTENCE WELL. 'One of these three hilltops is PEF Cartwheel' is handled only through the class-evidence denominator M, which is a blunt instrument: it dilutes all three equally and cannot represent that the evidence favours one of them. Proper handling needs a mutually-exclusive candidate-set construct that I have not specified and that would add real complexity.

7. VERIFICATION STOPS AT THE BYTES. A forgery that resolves at a real URL, contains the quoted span at the claimed offsets, and carries matching metadata scores at full strength. The model raises the cost of fabrication by orders of magnitude and does not eliminate it. The uploaded-PDF vector on open archives is partly handled by VX and partly not.

8. ORDINAL BANDS REDUCE SCORER NOISE BUT DO NOT REMOVE IT. sigma_L runs 6-8 dB against 7 dB bands, so band-edge candidates still re-grade. The improvement over v0.1 is that the noise is computed, published, and suppressed from the confidence chart rather than narrated as evidence. The register will have to live with, and say, that a meaningful fraction of D/C boundary cases are not stably distinguishable.

9. THE MODEL SAYS NOTHING ABOUT WHETHER A CANDIDATE IS WORTH SCORING. Prioritisation, coverage, and the COMPLETENESS CRITIC's regional-gap-filling incentive — which the IC analyst correctly identified as a candidate-manufacturing pressure — sit outside it. A find-rewarded fleet pointed at Montana will still return Montana adits; they will now grade F instead of C, which is better, but the register will fill with F rows and the cost of adjudicating them is real.

10. IT IS MORE EXPENSIVE PER CANDIDATE. Propositions multiply rows; receipted negative searches multiply queries; REFUTER now scores every observation; VERIFIER adds a fetch and a hash per source. A candidate that cost one adjudication pass under v0.1 costs perhaps five to eight here. That is the price of the thing working, but it should be stated before anyone budgets a sweep.
